repoNotFound.title: No repo selected
repoNotFound.body: This repository isn't in your workspace — it may have been removed, or the link is stale. Add a repo or pick another from the switcher to get started.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: This screen hit an unexpected error. Trying again re-renders it — the rest of the studio keeps working.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That URL doesn't match a screen in the studio. It may have been renamed, or the link is stale.
